verdict.rationale: Wave's own Pro page states it generates all three statements (profit & loss, balance sheet, and cash flow) automatically. Its accounting page says reports show month-to-month or year-to-year comparisons, and it describes the books as real double-entry accounting, which underpins accurate statements. missing for 10: explicit documentation of arbitrary custom date ranges for 'any period', independent or hands-on corroboration of report accuracy, and clarity on which plan tier includes the statements.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: Generate your profit & loss statement, balance sheet, and cash flow report automatically—no spreadsheets required.
show month-to-month or year-to-year comparisons so you can easily identify cash flow trends
Wave uses real, double-entry accounting software.
